---
title: "TAOOH first-order — estimand"
subtitle: "Weeks alive and out of hospital over 26 weeks"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Both treatment paths are predicted for the same observed participants used by
the primary TAOOH analysis. Two hundred posterior draws from each of 50
completed datasets are pooled with equal weight. Existing per-imputation
checkpoints are reused on later renders.

```{r}
#| label: derive-taooh-first-order-estimand
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)
data_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "imputations")
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "taooh-first-order", "models"
)
estimand_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "taooh-first-order", "estimand"
)
result_dir <- here::here("results", "supporting", "taooh-first-order")
figure_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "taooh-first-order", "figures"
)
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  sop_summary_path <- file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("sops-summary-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  sop_draws_path <- file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("sops-draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  comparison_summary_path <- file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("comparisons-summary-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  comparison_draws_path <- file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("comparisons-draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  estimand_paths <- c(
    sop_summary_path,
    sop_draws_path,
    comparison_summary_path,
    comparison_draws_path
  )
  if (!force && all(file.exists(estimand_paths))) next

  data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  model <- readRDS(model_path)

  sops <- mostr::avg_sops(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    times = 1:26,
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5L,
    p_var = "yprev",
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = config$markov$post_estimation_draws,
    seed = index,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )
  comparisons <- mostr::avg_comparisons(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    estimand = "time_in_state",
    state_sets = 1L,
    times = 1:26,
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5L,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    p_var = "yprev",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = config$markov$post_estimation_draws,
    seed = index,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )
  sop_draws <- attr(sops, "draws")
  comparison_draws <- attr(comparisons, "draws")
  if (is.null(sop_draws) || is.null(comparison_draws)) {
    stop("First-order TAOOH post-estimation must retain posterior draws.")
  }

  arrow::write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sops),
    sop_summary_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sop_draws),
    sop_draws_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparisons),
    comparison_summary_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparison_draws),
    comparison_draws_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}

comparison_draw_paths <- file.path(
  estimand_dir,
  sprintf("comparisons-draws-%02d.parquet", indices)
)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "home-time-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "home-time-comparison-draws.parquet")

pooled_output_is_current <- FALSE
if (file.exists(summary_path) && file.exists(draws_path)) {
  existing_pooled_draws <- arrow::read_parquet(draws_path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  pooled_output_is_current <-
    all(c("imputation", "draw") %in% names(existing_pooled_draws)) &&
    setequal(unique(existing_pooled_draws$imputation), indices) &&
    all(
      table(existing_pooled_draws$imputation) ==
        config$markov$post_estimation_draws
    )
}

if (force || !pooled_output_is_current) {
  comparison_draws <- lapply(seq_along(comparison_draw_paths), function(position) {
    draws <- arrow::read_parquet(comparison_draw_paths[[position]]) |>
      as.data.frame()
    if (!all(c("draw_id", "estimate") %in% names(draws))) {
      stop("First-order TAOOH contrasts must contain draw_id and estimate.")
    }
    if (
      nrow(draws) != config$markov$post_estimation_draws ||
        anyDuplicated(draws$draw_id)
    ) {
      stop("Each first-order fit must provide one contrast per posterior draw.")
    }
    draws |>
      mutate(
        imputation = indices[[position]],
        draw = estimate
      ) |>
      select(
        draw_id,
        imputation,
        draw,
        any_of(c("contrast", "comparison", "term", "state"))
      )
  })
  pooled <- bind_rows(comparison_draws)
  summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled$draw)
  summary$probability_benefit <- posterior_probability(pooled$draw)
  summary$state <- 1L
  summary$horizon_weeks <- 26L
  summary$imputations <- length(indices)
  summary$draws_per_imputation <- config$markov$post_estimation_draws

  arrow::write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(summary),
    summary_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(pooled, draws_path, compression = "zstd")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: build-taooh-first-order-plots
#| include: false

sop_draw_paths <- file.path(
  estimand_dir,
  sprintf("sops-draws-%02d.parquet", indices)
)
sop_draws <- lapply(seq_along(sop_draw_paths), function(position) {
  draws <- arrow::read_parquet(sop_draw_paths[[position]]) |>
    as.data.frame()
  if (!all(c("draw_id", "estimate", "time", "state", "tx") %in% names(draws))) {
    stop("First-order SOP draws lack required columns.")
  }
  if (
    length(unique(draws$draw_id)) !=
      config$markov$post_estimation_draws
  ) {
    stop("Each first-order SOP object must contain the configured draws.")
  }
  draws$imputation <- indices[[position]]
  draws
}) |>
  bind_rows()

state_labels <- c(
  "Alive/out of hospital",
  "Planned admission",
  "Emergency room",
  "Unplanned admission",
  "Dead"
)

pooled_sop_summary <- sop_draws |>
  mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = 1:5, labels = state_labels),
    tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Control", "Intervention"))
  ) |>
  group_by(tx, time, state) |>
  summarise(
    conf.low = quantile(estimate, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    conf.high = quantile(estimate, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    estimate = median(estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

arrow::write_parquet(
  pooled_sop_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "state-occupancy-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

model_sop_plot <- suppressMessages(
  mostr::plot_sops(
    pooled_sop_summary,
    facet_var = NULL,
    time_var = "time",
    estimate_var = "estimate",
    show_uncertainty = TRUE,
    linetype_var = "tx",
    ribbon_alpha = 0.5
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        rep("black", nlevels(pooled_sop_summary$state)),
        levels(pooled_sop_summary$state)
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Posterior state occupancy probability",
    color = "TAOOH state",
    fill = "TAOOH state",
    linetype = "Treatment group",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "model-state-occupancy-pooled.png"),
  model_sop_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

comparison_plot_draws <- arrow::read_parquet(draws_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

home_time_posterior_plot <- ggplot(comparison_plot_draws, aes(x = draw)) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
    point_interval = ggdist::median_qi
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "Difference in time alive and out of hospital over 26 weeks ",
      "(intervention - control), weeks"
    ),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "home-time-difference-posterior.png"),
  home_time_posterior_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
